jobs.title: Registered Nurse - AI ChatBot Reviewer (US, Remote)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking experienced US registered nurses to review and assess AI-generated responses from a health coaching agent, with a focus on safety, regulatory compliance, and clinical content accuracy. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated review platform, performing short, structured evaluations to help train and refine AI models for patient-facing health guidance. This is a remote, flexible and short-term project. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Structured Grading: Score AI agent responses against a pre-defined rubric, applying the highest-priority criteria consistently across a large volume of items. - Safety Review: Identify responses that could cause patient harm missed red flags, unsafe advice, failure to escalate or signpost to care. - Clinical Accuracy: Assess factual correctness, completeness and guideline alignment of clinical content. - Written Feedback: Provide brief, specific rationale for each failed response and general guidance on how it could be improved. QUALIFICATIONS - Licensure: Active RN license for US - Experience: Minimum 2 years of clinical nursing practice. - Knowledge: Strong grounding in clinical guidelines, patient safety and scope-of-practice boundaries. - Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in clinical documentation or review work. - Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured review tools and digital platforms. - Language: Native or near-native written English. jobs.title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (USA)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models. This is a remote, flexible and short-term project. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule. - Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion. - Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn. - Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies. - Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined. This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions. jobs.description_text: Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFR CT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFR CT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare. Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide. The Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) - Investigator Initiated Studies is responsible for the oversight and management of all clinical operational activities for investigator initiated studies. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.
